panel.doc: Clear the side panel and head it.

fact.doc: A bulleted line in the panel (under 90 characters).

stat.doc: A big number with a label.

bars.doc: A bar chart in the panel, at most 6 bars.

compare.doc: Two numbers side by side. With columns: two or three kinds side by side on the stage, each {title, entity?, points}.

timeline.doc: A time line: [[date, label], ...], at most 6 in the panel, 7 across the stage (where: stage).

network.doc: People and alliances: nodes and edges.

marker.doc: A labelled dot at a place, anchor or [lon, lat].

river.doc: A Natural Earth river by English name.

path.doc: A hand-drawn line: a region feature name or [[lon, lat], ...].

route.doc: A curved arrow through places, with optional dated waypoint labels.

dim.doc: Fade filled areas down before highlighting one.

move.doc: Move a unit to a place.

charge.doc: A unit charges a place or unit.

rout.doc: A unit breaks and falls back.

volley.doc: A unit fires at a unit or place.

clock.doc: Turn the battle clock to HH:MM.

highlight.doc: Draw the eye to a unit or place.

icon.doc: Deprecated: lectures use no icons. Drawn as a labelled marker at its places, or as a fact line in the panel.

figure.doc: A figure from a source document, by id: on the stage (default), in the panel, or across the frame for one beat.

photo.doc: A real photograph, on the stage, full frame or in the panel: a Commons title, a query, or a subject (a person, movement, monument, event or place by its English name: Wikipedia's picture of it).

illustration.doc: An educational illustration or diagram on the stage (Wikimedia Commons, Openverse; reusable licences, credited): what it shows, in English.

molecule.doc: A structural formula on the stage: a name, formula (H2O) or SMILES.

equation.doc: A law or reaction, large on the stage (LaTeX-style: E = mc^2, H_2O, ->).

plot.doc: Graphs of functions of x on the stage.

process.doc: Steps joined by arrows on the stage; cycle for cycles.

quote.doc: A primary source in its own words, on the stage.

gallery.doc: Two to four pictures on the stage together, for a paragraph about several people, communities or historic places: items [{subject|image|figure|illustration, caption}].

diagram.doc: A diagram built on the stage from SVG drawings of the things (entity: an English word) and arrows; kind flow|cycle|tree|hub; show some nodes now, reveal the rest across the paragraph.

reveal.doc: The next nodes of a diagram drawn earlier in the chapter, with their arrows.

focus.doc: A ring around one node of a diagram while the narration talks about it.

define.doc: A hard word on the stage with its meaning in plain words (and a drawing of it).

question.doc: A question for the class on the stage, then time to think (think seconds, 5 by default). choices: 2-4 short answers; answer: the right choice's letter, or the answer in words.

answer.doc: Show the answer to the question on the stage, on the beat that explains it.

incline.doc: A block on a wedge: angle, friction, forces [mg, N, f, F], components (mg sinθ, mg cosθ), applied (up|down). Parts: ground, wedge, theta, block, mg, N, f, F, mg_sin, mg_cos. Reveal parts with reveal/focus by these ids.

pulley.doc: kind atwood (two hanging masses) or table (a block on a table and a hanging mass). Parts: ceiling|table, pulley, rope, m1, m2, T1, T2, W1, W2, N, f, a1, a2. Reveal parts with reveal/focus by these ids.

piston.doc: A gas under a piston. Parts: cylinder, gas, piston, rod, F, P, Q. Reveal parts with reveal/focus by these ids.

spring.doc: A block on a spring from a wall. Parts: wall, ground, spring, block, F, x. Reveal parts with reveal/focus by these ids.

pendulum.doc: A bob on a string. Parts: support, rest, string, theta, swing, bob, T, mg. Reveal parts with reveal/focus by these ids.

projectile.doc: A launch at an angle. Parts: ground, path, u, ux, uy, theta, top, H, R. Reveal parts with reveal/focus by these ids.

circuit.doc: A battery and resistors, kind series|parallel. Parts: battery, wire, R1, R2, R3, I. Reveal parts with reveal/focus by these ids.

lever.doc: A beam on a fulcrum with two loads. Parts: ground, fulcrum, beam, L1, L2, d1, d2. Reveal parts with reveal/focus by these ids.

lens.doc: A thin lens forming an image. Parts: axis, lens, F1, F2, object, ray1, ray2, image. Reveal parts with reveal/focus by these ids.

sketch.doc: A labelled diagram from primitives in a 10 x 6 box (y up): line, arrow, rect, circle, polygon, spring, ground, angle, dim, dot, text, curve; each {id?, type, from/to|at|points, label?, color?, fill?, dashed?}.

graph.doc: Axes with items [{id, kind: curve|point|vline|hline|area|tangent|segment|data|label, ...}] revealed a beat at a time.

work.doc: Lines of a worked solution (TeX), added under the last ones; box rings the answer.

problem.doc: A long question: statement across the top, its figure (a sketch, graph or preset op) on the left, its solution (work with the same id) on the right.

motion.doc: A drawn diagram moving, only on the beat whose narration says what moves. Presets move as they would (live: true keeps it going for the line); on a sketch, kind move|turn|pulse|orbit|spin|vibrate|follow|flow with parts, by, angle, about, through, along.

trace.doc: A point riding a curve of a graph over the line, with its tangent, the area under it and a live readout (value|slope|area).

sweep.doc: A graph's curve redrawn as one number in its equation changes from one value to another, the number shown live.

zoom.doc: Move in on one part (node) of the picture on the stage; without node, back out.

sim.doc: A moving simulation for the line. kind: orbit (period, radius, vectors), wave (wave: travelling|standing|superpose, amplitude, wavelength, speed), collision (m1, m2, u1, u2, elastic), field (charges [[q,x,y]], lines, test), refraction (n1, n2, from_deg, to_deg), titration (kind, indicator, equivalence), mitosis, heart (bpm, flow), gas (particles, speed, hot), decay (atoms, half_life, curve).

counter.doc: A value counting from one number to another over the line (style bar|dial|number).
